description: This Java class defines 'ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetter', a final immutable class that extends AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter to conditionally add acknowledgement requests to 'ThingModifyCommand' objects, based on specified labels like TWIN_PERSISTED. It includes singleton instantiation and methods to apply acknowledgement headers, check applicability, and retrieve class type info.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetter
classes.description: A final immutable class extending AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter to set acknowledgment requests on 'ThingModifyCommand' instances, implementing singleton pattern and methods for applicability checks and class matching.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Deprecated method that wraps 'apply(ThingModifyCommand)' to add acknowledgment headers to a generic Command if applicable.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the command is a 'ThingModifyCommand' and applicable for adding acknowledgment requests, excluding live channel commands.

methods.name: getMatchedClass
methods.description: Returns the 'Class' object representing 'ThingModifyCommand' for matching purposes.

methods.name: isBindResponseRequiredToAddingRemovingImplicitLabel
methods.description: Indicates whether binding responses are required when adding or removing implicit labels; returns false.
